page_title: VIL 0-0 CAD | Villarreal v Cadiz CF 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
90+4' Alex Baena (Villarreal) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
90+3' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) replacing Gonzalo Escalante.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) comes onto the pitch for Ruben Sobrino.
90+2' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has finally had enough of Marcelino and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by Villarreal is thwarted by the well prepared Conan Ledesma (Cadiz).
89' A substitution has been made. Francis Coquelin is replaced by Manu Trigueros (Villarreal).
89' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
86' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) misses a promising chance to score from the free kick, but Filip Jorgensen makes a decent save.
83' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
82' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to substitute Robert Navarro and he is replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
82' Substitution. Chris Ramos is replaced by Brian Ocampo (Cadiz).
79' The attendance is 17183.
78' Alex Baena (Villarreal) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
75' Here is a change. Ivan Alejo is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Juanmi (Cadiz).
74' Alex Baena (Villarreal) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
73' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
72' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Substitution. Santi Comesana leaves the pitch and is replaced by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal).
69' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
67' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
60' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
58' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
55' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals NO PENALTY for Villarreal after a VAR review!
54' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Villarreal! Let's see what he decides.
52' Villarreal fail to score from a corner as Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) leaps to collect the ball.
50' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. A free kick is awarded to Villarreal.
47' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.
46' Half-time substitution. Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is replaced by Goncalo Guedes.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) comes off for Jose Luis Morales.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.

45+2' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
42' Poor challenge! Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle.
40' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

38' Alex Baena (Villarreal) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
35' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Filip Jorgensen has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
33' The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Villarreal, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.

30' Villarreal slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
25' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
24' None of the Villarreal players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
22' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
21' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) blows a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounced on a rebound but headed it just over the crossbar.
19' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Cadiz CF.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
17' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
14' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
12' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Conan Ledesma makes a smart save to deny him.
10' Handball by Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal).
9' The referee blows his whistle as Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge.
9' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
5' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
3' Conan Ledesma is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Santi Comesana (Villarreal). Easy save!
2' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
1' The first half has started.
Cadiz CF will kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will referee today's match.
